Bounding box ~346x182 px in the 1600x1035 render (aspect ~1.9:1 wide). Stroke width ~50-55 px (~30% of shape height); interior slot between the bars is about one stroke-width tall (~50 px) and runs open all the way out the left side. Path: round-cap start at top-left (~x262), run right ~85% of width along a nearly straight, slightly wavy top bar; two rounded ~90-degree corners (outer corner radius ~= stroke width, inner slot end fully rounded) forming the right-side U-turn down ~130 px; return left along the bottom bar to a round cap roughly flush below the start point. Bars are close to parallel; mild organic waviness (+/-3% of height bumps) from the LED/photo source.

eye_R.rotation: top bar horizontal; bottom bar droops ~5-8 deg downward toward its right (outer) end
eye_R.detail: Mirror construction of eye_L: squared 'C' / '⊂' — two near-horizontal bars joined by a short vertical connector on the LEFT (inner/face-center) side, opening to the RIGHT. Bounding box ~335x185 px, aspect ~1.8:1. Stroke width ~50-55 px; interior slot ~one stroke-width tall, open out the right side. Rounded ~90-degree corners at the left U-turn (outer radius ~= stroke width). Free ends on the right have round caps. Asymmetry vs left eye: the bottom bar sags — it slants down toward the right, ending ~15-20% of shape height lower than the top bar's end, and extends slightly further right than the top bar, giving a slight tapered droop at its cap; top bar stays level.

mouth.detail: Tiny solid filled dot, near-circular ellipse very slightly wider than tall (~1.1:1), diameter ~45-50 px (~ equal to the eye stroke width, ~1/7 of an eye's width). Centered horizontally on the face (x~800/1600), sitting well below the eye line (center y~745 vs eye centers y~470, i.e. ~1.5 eye-heights below). No flat edges — smooth round blob with soft glow halo.

"mouth: dot" is correct.
